items.title: Phil Flanigan interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998

ctx.x: Grady, possibly Grady. I can’t remember who the drummer was, forgive me whoever it was, but so they warmed up to Scott immediately there, because he’s playing music from their era and nobody has done this, everybody is going [scats] for twenty-five years before that. You know going one-four [scats]. These are my ways of making the over- academicized music sort of to turn it into an onomatopoeia if you will. See I can do it too, academia.
